title: What Solid-State Lithium Batteries Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Solid-state lithium batteries replace the flammable liquid electrolyte of lithium-ion cells with a solid ceramic or polymer conductor. The result is a battery that stores more energy, charges faster, and cannot catch fire — the enabling technology for long-range EVs and electric aviation. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Solid-State Lithium Batteries: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Solid-State Lithium Batteries in one line: Solid-state lithium batteries replace the flammable liquid electrolyte of lithium-ion cells with a solid ceramic or polymer conductor.
Why it matters: They remove the fire risk and energy ceiling of today's batteries in one stroke..
Where it is used: electric vehicles, electric aircraft, grid storage, wearables, medical implants..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of Solid-State Lithium Batteries
title: Current Research State of Solid-State Lithium Batteries
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Toyota, Samsung, and startups demonstrated prototype cells with 400-500 Wh/kg; sulfide and oxide electrolytes lead. Research focuses on dendrite suppression, interfacial resistance, and manufacturability. Pilot lines now produce cells; the gap is cost and cycle life at scale. Research moves in three waves: laboratory proof of concept, scaled prototypes under controlled conditions, and field trials. Solid-State Lithium Batteries currently sits at the stage described above, and the pieces records show what each wave still needs.
